title: Remote foundations M5: one central host with one, then two, satellites — end-to-end coordination through the central host
outcome: Remote foundations M5: one central host with one, then two, satellites — end-to-end coordination through the central host
acceptance: An integration test with one central TermAl process and two satellite processes (one machine, loopback/fake link) shows ordinary agent mailbox APIs behave identically on every host while one central host holds all session/mailbox authority: an assignment, a report and a reply flow between sessions on different satellites only through the central host, never satellite-to-satellite.

Authenticated access is enforced; wrong-host ids and ACL violations are rejected; with the central host down every remote authoritative read fails visibly while outbox status stays separate, and already-admitted local execution is not shown as central availability.
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
